exposure: homozygous missense mutation c.1007A.G (p.Gln336Arg) in EPG5 gene
cohort: The study describes a 5-year-old girl diagnosed with Vici syndrome due to a homozygous missense mutation in the EPG5 gene.
finding: The primary finding is the first reported association of EPG5-related Vici syndrome with severe central sleep apnea (CSA).
